item.title: One person taken to hospital, traffic stalled after car strikes deer on Route 6 in Orleans
item.description: ORLEANS – One person was injured after their vehicle reportedly struck a deer. The crash happened shortly before noon on Route 6 westbound just past Exit 89 (Route 6A). The driver was transported to Cape Cod Hospital for evaluation. Traffic was stalled until the vehicle could be removed. item.title: Discovery of life jacket floating in water prompts search of Wellfleet harbor
item.description: WELLFLEET – The discovery of a life jacket floating in the water prompted a search of Wellfleet harbor late Monday morning. The search appeared to be centered on the area of Jeremy’s Point. The search did not result in any further findings and was suspended pending further development. Photos by AAP/CWN The post Discovery of life jacket floating in water prompts search of Wellfleet harbor appeared first on CapeCod.com.

item.title: Gas line struck on Route 28 in Yarmouth causing traffic slowdowns
item.description: YARMOUTH – A construction crew reportedly part of the sewer installation crew struck a gas line on Route 28 in Yarmouth shortly before 1 PM Monday. The incident happened by College Street just west of Winslow Gray Road. National Grid was called to the scene. Traffic delays were likely in the area.
